selection_basis.reason: High decision relevance with exact ablation and efficiency claims about subgoal-local context folding.

source.title: HIPIF: Hierarchical Planning and Information Folding for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Learning

verified_claims.claim: Qwen2.5-3B HIPIF reports ALFWorld 96.1, VirtualHome 63.3, ScienceWorld 64.8; removing reflection gives 87.8/53.9/49.2; removing process reward 90.3/57.9/57.0; removing subgoal structure 73.9/46.9/43.1.
Qwen2.5-7B HIPIF reports 99.2/68.8/71.5; w/o Subgoal reports 87.5/59.9/63.5.
3B efficiency: HIPIF uses 16.5 steps/16.6k tokens on ALFWorld, 29.5/33.5k on VirtualHome, 15.0/22.0k on ScienceWorld; w/o Subgoal uses 38.0/37.8k, 37.1/42.8k, 19.1/28.7k.
HIPIF explicitly organizes execution around subgoals and folds completed subgoal histories while retaining detailed current-subgoal execution.

corrections_or_clarifications.verified_scope: The w/o-Subgoal ablation removes the explicit subgoal decomposition AND context-folding structure together. Therefore the large drop does not isolate 'folding' from 'subgoal decomposition' as separate causal factors. Downstream claims should attribute the result to the combined subgoal+folding structure unless a finer ablation is found.

The quantitative evidence is from RL-trained Qwen2.5-3B/7B agents on ALFWorld, VirtualHome, and ScienceWorld under the paper's training protocol. It supports a mechanism candidate for stage-aware context organization, not direct efficacy in repository agents or frozen frontier-model chat systems.

HIPIF has lower average steps/tokens than the tested ablations/baselines in Table 3. Because the method also changes training/reward/reflection, the efficiency gain should not be assigned solely to information folding.

unresolved_gaps: No independent replication verified in this run.
A direct decomposition-only vs folding-only ablation was not located in the checked primary evidence.
Transfer to non-RL or code/repository long-horizon agents remains untested by this paper.

downstream_action.integrator: May treat the worker's HIPIF Table 2 and Table 3 numbers as primary-verified. Phrase the central ablation as combined explicit-subgoal + context-folding structure, not folding alone.
downstream_action.evidence_comparator: High primary-source confidence for the reported benchmark/ablation values; causal isolation of folding from subgoal decomposition is incomplete and independent replication is absent.
